feeding_claim.verbatim: The beef is from a healthy animal that lived its life grazing on pastures.

availability.note: Farm store is open seasonally from mid to late April until October.

resold_note: The farm store also sells locally made ice cream, local groceries and beer from Stone Cow Brewery.
notes: Scout 2026-11-25: read the carterandstevensfarm.com homepage, About the Farm, Farm Store and FAQ pages (site name styled Carter & Steven's Family Farm; Verifier: check preferred farm_name). Pasture-based dairy; farm store sells its own grass-fed beef and raw milk bottled daily (site says raw milk, not the word unpasteurized). Category grass-fed because no finishing wording was found. Farm store page says beef is available in bulk with many cuts, but no quarter, half or whole shares are named, so bulk_shares is false; Verifier: check. 2026 season hours were Thursday and Sunday 11am to 7pm, Friday and Saturday 11am to 8pm; store closes for the winter, so availability is paused. Site also runs Stone Cow Kitchen, a BBQ venue and Stone Cow Brewery. No delivery or shipping mentioned.
